traditions.WLC: בַּ שָּׁנָה֙ הָ עֲשִׂירִ֔ית
traditions.LXX: Ἐν τῷ ἔτει τῷ δωδεκάτῳ
traditions.VUL: In anno décimo ,
traditions.KJV: In the tenth year ,

traditions.WLC: בָּ עֲשִׂרִ֕י
traditions.LXX: ἐν δεκάτῳ μηνὶ
traditions.VUL: décimo mense ,
traditions.KJV: in the tenth [ month ] ,

1.english_reference: in the twelfth [ day ] of the month

traditions.WLC: בִּ שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר לַ חֹ֑דֶשׁ
traditions.LXX: μιᾷ τοῦ μηνὸς
traditions.VUL: undécima die mensis ,
traditions.KJV: in the twelfth [ day ] of the month ,

1.english_reference: the word of the LORD came unto me , saying ,

traditions.WLC: הָיָ֥ה דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥ י לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: ἐγένετο λόγος Κυρίου πρὸς μὲ λέγων
traditions.VUL: factum est verbum Dómini ad me , dicens :
traditions.KJV: the word of the LORD came unto me , saying ,

traditions.WLC: בֶּן אָדָ֕ם
traditions.LXX: Υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου ,
traditions.VUL: Fili hóminis
traditions.KJV: Son of man ,

2.english_reference: set thy face against Pharaoh king of Egypt

traditions.WLC: שִׂ֣ים פָּנֶ֔י ךָ עַל פַּרְעֹ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרָ֑יִם
traditions.LXX: στήρισον τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἐπὶ Φαραὼ βασιλέα Αἰγύπτου ,
traditions.VUL: pone fáciem tuam contra Pharaónem regem Ægýpti ,
traditions.KJV: set thy face against Pharaoh king of Egypt ,

2.english_reference: and prophesy against him , and against all Egypt :

traditions.WLC: וְ הִנָּבֵ֣א עָלָ֔י ו וְ עַל מִצְרַ֖יִם כֻּלָּֽ הּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ προφήτευσον ἐπ᾽ αὐτὸν καὶ ἐπ᾽ Αἴγυπτον ὅλην
traditions.VUL: et prophetábis de eo , et de Ægýpto univérsa .
traditions.KJV: and prophesy against him , and against all Egypt :

3.english_reference: Speak , and say , Thus saith the Lord GOD ;

traditions.WLC: דַּבֵּ֨ר וְ אָמַרְתָּ֜ כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣ י יְהוִ֗ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἰπόν Τάδε λέγει Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Lóquere , et dices : Hæc dicit Dóminus Deus :
traditions.KJV: Speak , and say , Thus saith the Lord GOD ;

3.english_reference: Behold , I [ am ] against thee , Pharaoh king of Egypt

traditions.WLC: הִנְ נִ֤י עָלֶ֨י ךָ֙ פַּרְעֹ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם
traditions.LXX: Ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐπὶ Φαραώ ,
traditions.VUL: Ecce ego ad te , Phárao rex Ægýpti ,
traditions.KJV: Behold , I [ am ] against thee , Pharaoh king of Egypt ,

3.english_reference: the great dragon that lieth in the midst of his rivers

traditions.WLC: הַ תַּנִּים֙ הַ גָּד֔וֹל הָ רֹבֵ֖ץ בְּ ת֣וֹךְ יְאֹרָ֑י
traditions.LXX: τὸν δράκοντα τὸν μέγαν τὸν ἐγκαθήμενον ἐν μέσῳ ποταμῶν αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: draco magne , qui cubas in médio flúminum tuórum ,
traditions.KJV: the great dragon that lieth in the midst of his rivers ,

3.english_reference: which hath said , My river [ is ] mine own , and I have made [ it ] for myself .

traditions.WLC: ו אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָמַ֛ר לִ֥ י יְאֹרִ֖ י וַ אֲנִ֥י עֲשִׂיתִֽ נִי
traditions.LXX: τὸν λέγοντα Ἐμοί εἰσιν οἱ ποταμοί , καὶ ἐγὼ ἐποίησα αὐτούς .
traditions.VUL: et dicis : Meus est flúvius , et ego feci memetípsum .
traditions.KJV: which hath said , My river [ is ] mine own , and I have made [ it ] for myself .

4.english_reference: But I will put hooks in thy jaws

traditions.WLC: וְ נָתַתִּ֤י חחיים בִּ לְחָיֶ֔י ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγὼ δώσω παγίδας εἰς τὰς σιαγόνας σου ,
traditions.VUL: Et ponam frenum in maxíllis tuis ,
traditions.KJV: But I will put hooks in thy jaws ,

4.english_reference: and I will cause the fish of thy rivers to stick unto thy scales

traditions.WLC: וְ הִדְבַּקְתִּ֥י דְגַת יְאֹרֶ֖י ךָ בְּ קַשְׂקְשֹׂתֶ֑י ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ προσκολλήσω τοὺς ἰχθῦς τοῦ ποταμοῦ σου πρὸς τὰς πτέρυγάς σου ,
traditions.VUL: et agglutinábo pisces flúminum tuórum squamis tuis :
traditions.KJV: and I will cause the fish of thy rivers to stick unto thy scales ,

4.english_reference: and I will bring thee up out of the midst of thy rivers

traditions.WLC: וְ הַעֲלִיתִ֨י ךָ֙ מִ תּ֣וֹךְ יְאֹרֶ֔י ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνάξω σε ἐκ μέσου τοῦ ποταμοῦ σου ,
traditions.VUL: et éxtraham te de médio flúminum tuórum ,
traditions.KJV: and I will bring thee up out of the midst of thy rivers ,

4.english_reference: and all the fish of thy rivers shall stick unto thy scales .

traditions.WLC: וְ אֵת֙ כָּל דְּגַ֣ת יְאֹרֶ֔י ךָ בְּ קַשְׂקְשֹׂתֶ֖י ךָ תִּדְבָּֽק
traditions.VUL: et univérsi pisces tui squamis tuis adhærébunt .
traditions.KJV: and all the fish of thy rivers shall stick unto thy scales .

5.english_reference: And I will leave thee [ thrown ] into the wilderness , thee and all the fish of thy rivers :

traditions.WLC: וּ נְטַשְׁתִּ֣י ךָ הַ מִּדְבָּ֗רָ ה אוֹתְ ךָ֙ וְ אֵת֙ כָּל דְּגַ֣ת יְאֹרֶ֔י ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ καταβαλῶ σε ἐν τάχει καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἰχθύας τοῦ ποταμοῦ σου ·
traditions.VUL: Et proíciam te in desértum , et omnes pisces flúminis tui :
traditions.KJV: And I will leave thee [ thrown ] into the wilderness , thee and all the fish of thy rivers :

5.english_reference: thou shalt fall upon the open fields ;

traditions.WLC: עַל פְּנֵ֤י הַ שָּׂדֶה֙ תִּפּ֔וֹל
traditions.LXX: ἐπὶ πρόσωπον τοῦ πεδίου πεσῇ ,
traditions.VUL: super fáciem terræ cades ,
traditions.KJV: thou shalt fall upon the open fields ;

5.english_reference: thou shalt not be brought together , nor gathered :

traditions.WLC: לֹ֥א תֵאָסֵ֖ף וְ לֹ֣א תִקָּבֵ֑ץ
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐ μὴ συναχθῇς καὶ οὐ μὴ περισταλῇς ,
traditions.VUL: non colligéris , neque congregáberis :
traditions.KJV: thou shalt not be brought together , nor gathered :

5.english_reference: I have given thee for meat to the beasts of the field and to the fowls of the heaven .

traditions.WLC: לְ חַיַּ֥ת הָ אָ֛רֶץ וּ לְ ע֥וֹף הַ שָּׁמַ֖יִם נְתַתִּ֥י ךָ לְ אָכְלָֽה
traditions.LXX: τοῖς θηρίοις τῆς γῆς καὶ τοῖς πετεινοῖς τοῦ οὐρανοῦ δέδωκά σε εἰς κατάβρωμα ·
traditions.VUL: béstiis terræ , et volatílibus cæli dedi te ad devorándum .
traditions.KJV: I have given thee for meat to the beasts of the field and to the fowls of the heaven .

6.english_reference: And all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I [ am ] the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: וְ יָֽדְעוּ֙ כָּל יֹשְׁבֵ֣י מִצְרַ֔יִם כִּ֖י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ γνώσονται πάντες οἱ κατοικοῦντες Αἴγυπτον ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι Κύριος ,
traditions.VUL: Et scient omnes habitatóres Ægýpti quia ego Dóminus :
traditions.KJV: And all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I [ am ] the LORD ,

6.english_reference: because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel .

traditions.WLC: יַ֧עַן הֱיוֹתָ֛ ם מִשְׁעֶ֥נֶת קָנֶ֖ה לְ בֵ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.LXX: ἀνθ᾽ ὧν ἐγενήθης ῥάβδος καλαμίνη τῷ οἴκῳ Ἰσραήλ .
traditions.VUL: pro eo quod fuísti báculus arundíneus dómui Israel .
traditions.KJV: because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel .

7.english_reference: When they took hold of thee by thy hand , thou didst break , and rend all their shoulder :

traditions.WLC: בְּ תָפְשָׂ֨ ם בְּ ךָ֤ ב כפ ך תֵּר֔וֹץ וּ בָקַעְתָּ֥ לָ הֶ֖ם כָּל כָּתֵ֑ף
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐπελάβετό σου τῇ χειρὶ αὐτῶν , ἐθλάσθης · καὶ ὅτε ἐκρότησεν ἐπ᾽ αὐτοὺς πᾶσα χείρ ,
traditions.VUL: Quando apprehendérunt te manu , et confráctus es , et lacerásti omnem húmerum eórum :
traditions.KJV: When they took hold of thee by thy hand , thou didst break , and rend all their shoulder :

7.english_reference: and when they leaned upon thee , thou brakest , and madest all their loins to be at a stand .

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ הִֽשָּׁעֲנָ֤ ם עָלֶ֨י ךָ֙ תִּשָּׁבֵ֔ר וְ הַעֲמַדְתָּ֥ לָ הֶ֖ם כָּל מָתְנָֽיִם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὅτε ἐπανεπαύσαντο ἐπὶ σέ , συνετρίβης , καὶ συνέκλασας αὐτῶν πᾶσαν ὀσφύν .
traditions.VUL: et inniténtibus eis super te comminútus es , et dissolvísti omnes renes eórum .
traditions.KJV: and when they leaned upon thee , thou brakest , and madest all their loins to be at a stand .

8.english_reference: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ;

traditions.WLC: לָ כֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣ י יְהוִ֔ה
traditions.LXX: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Proptérea hæc dicit Dóminus Deus :
traditions.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ;

8.english_reference: Behold , I will bring a sword upon thee ,

traditions.WLC: הִנְ נִ֛י מֵבִ֥יא עָלַ֖יִ ךְ חָ֑רֶב
traditions.LXX: Ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐπάγω ἐπὶ σέ ῥομφαίαν ,
traditions.VUL: Ecce ego addúcam super te gládium ,
traditions.KJV: Behold , I will bring a sword upon thee ,

8.english_reference: and cut off man and beast out of thee .

traditions.WLC: וְ הִכְרַתִּ֥י מִמֵּ֖ ךְ אָדָ֥ם וּ בְהֵמָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπολῶ ἀνθρώπους ἀπὸ σοῦ καὶ κτήνη ,
traditions.VUL: et interfíciam de te hóminem , et iuméntum .
traditions.KJV: and cut off man and beast out of thee .

9.english_reference: And the land of Egypt shall be desolate and waste ;

traditions.WLC: וְ הָיְתָ֤ה אֶֽרֶץ מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ לִ שְׁמָמָ֣ה וְ חָרְבָּ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσται ἡ γῆ Αἰγύπτου ἀπώλεια καὶ ἔρημος ·
traditions.VUL: Et erit terra Ægýpti in desértum , et in solitúdinem :
traditions.KJV: And the land of Egypt shall be desolate and waste ;

9.english_reference: and they shall know that I [ am ] the LORD :

traditions.WLC: וְ יָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ γνώσονται ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι Κύριος ,
traditions.VUL: et scient quia ego Dóminus ,
traditions.KJV: and they shall know that I [ am ] the LORD :

9.english_reference: because he hath said , The river [ is ] mine , and I have made [ it ] .

traditions.WLC: יַ֧עַן אָמַ֛ר יְאֹ֥ר לִ֖ י וַ אֲנִ֥י עָשִֽׂיתִי
traditions.LXX: ἀντὶ τοῦ λέγειν σε Οἱ ποταμοὶ ἐμοί εἰσιν , καὶ ἐγὼ ἐποίησα αὐτούς .
traditions.VUL: pro eo quod díxeris : Flúvius meus est , et ego feci eum .
traditions.KJV: because he hath said , The river [ is ] mine , and I have made [ it ] .

10.english_reference: Behold , therefore I [ am ] against thee , and against thy rivers ,

traditions.WLC: לָ כֵ֛ן הִנְ נִ֥י אֵלֶ֖י ךָ וְ אֶל יְאֹרֶ֑י ךָ
traditions.LXX: διὰ τοῦτο ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐπὶ σὲ καὶ ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς ποταμούς σου ,
traditions.VUL: Idcírco ecce ego ad te , et ad flúmina tua :
traditions.KJV: Behold , therefore I [ am ] against thee , and against thy rivers ,

10.english_reference: and I will make the land of Egypt utterly waste [ and ] desolate ,

traditions.WLC: וְ נָתַתִּ֞י אֶת אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֗יִם לְ חָרְבוֹת֙ חֹ֣רֶב שְׁמָמָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ δώσω γῆν Αἰγύπτου εἰς ἔρημον ῥομφαίαν καὶ ἀπωλίαν ,
traditions.VUL: dabóque terram Ægýpti in solitúdines , gládio dissipátam ,
traditions.KJV: and I will make the land of Egypt utterly waste [ and ] desolate ,

10.english_reference: from the tower of Syene even unto the border of Ethiopia .

traditions.WLC: מִ מִּגְדֹּ֥ל סְוֵנֵ֖ה וְ עַד גְּב֥וּל כּֽוּשׁ
traditions.LXX: ἀπὸ Μαγδώλου καὶ Συήνης καὶ ἕως ὁρίων Αἰθιόπων .
traditions.VUL: a turre Syénes usque ad términes Æthiópiæ .
traditions.KJV: from the tower of Syene even unto the border of Ethiopia .

11.english_reference: No foot of man shall pass through it

traditions.WLC: לֹ֤א תַעֲבָר בָּ הּ֙ רֶ֣גֶל אָדָ֔ם
traditions.LXX: οὐ μὴ διέλθῃ ἐν αὐτῇ ποὺς ἀνθρώπου ,
traditions.VUL: Non pertransíbit eam pes hóminis ,
traditions.KJV: No foot of man shall pass through it ,

11.english_reference: nor foot of beast shall pass through it

traditions.WLC: וְ רֶ֥גֶל בְּהֵמָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲבָר בָּ֑ הּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ποὺς κτήνους οὐ μὴ διέλθῃ αὐτήν ,
traditions.VUL: neque pes iuménti gradiétur in ea :
traditions.KJV: nor foot of beast shall pass through it ,

11.english_reference: neither shall it be inhabited forty years

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹ֥א תֵשֵׁ֖ב אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐ κατοικηθήσεται τεσσεράκοντα ἔτη .
traditions.VUL: et non habitábitur quadragínta annis .
traditions.KJV: neither shall it be inhabited forty years .

12.english_reference: And I will make the land of Egypt desolate in the midst of the countries [ that are ] desolate

traditions.WLC: וְ נָתַתִּ֣י אֶת אֶרֶץ֩ מִצְרַ֨יִם שְׁמָמָ֜ה בְּ ת֣וֹךְ אֲרָצ֣וֹת נְשַׁמּ֗וֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ δώσω τὴν γῆν αὐτῆς ἀπώλειαν ἐν μέσῳ γῆς ἠρημωμένης ,
traditions.VUL: Dabóque terram Ægýpti desértam in médio terrárum desertárum ,
traditions.KJV: And I will make the land of Egypt desolate in the midst of the countries [ that are ] desolate ,

12.english_reference: and her cities among the cities [ that are ] laid waste shall be desolate forty years

traditions.WLC: וְ עָרֶ֨י הָ֙ בְּ ת֨וֹךְ עָרִ֤ים מָֽחֳרָבוֹת֙ תִּֽהְיֶ֣יןָ שְׁמָמָ֔ה אַרְבָּעִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ αἱ πόλεις αὐτῆς ἐν μέσῳ πόλεων ἠρημωμένων ἔσονται τεσσεράκοντα ἔτη .
traditions.VUL: et civitátes eius in médio úrbium subversárum , et erunt desolátæ quadragínta annis :
traditions.KJV: and her cities among the cities [ that are ] laid waste shall be desolate forty years :

12.english_reference: and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations

traditions.WLC: וַ הֲפִצֹתִ֤י אֶת מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ בַּ גּוֹיִ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ διασπερῶ Αἴγυπτον ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ,
traditions.VUL: et dispérgam Ægýptios in natiónes ,
traditions.KJV: and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations ,

12.english_reference: and will disperse them through the countries

traditions.WLC: וְֽ זֵרִיתִ֖י ם בָּ אֲרָצֽוֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ λικμήσω αὐτοὺς εἰς τὰς χώρας .
traditions.VUL: et ventilábo eos in terras .
traditions.KJV: and will disperse them through the countries .

13.english_reference: Yet thus saith the Lord GOD

traditions.WLC: כִּ֛י כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣ י יְהוִ֑ה
traditions.LXX: τάδε λέγει Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Quia hæc dicit Dóminus Deus :
traditions.KJV: Yet thus saith the Lord GOD ;

13.english_reference: At the end of forty years will I gather the Egyptians from the people whither they were scattered

traditions.WLC: מִ קֵּ֞ץ אַרְבָּעִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ אֲקַבֵּ֣ץ אֶת מִצְרַ֔יִם מִן הָ עַמִּ֖ים אֲשֶׁר נָפֹ֥צוּ שָֽׁמָּ ה
traditions.LXX: Μετὰ τεσσεράκοντα ἔτη συνάξω Αἰγυπτίους ἀπὸ τῶν ἐθνῶν οὗ διεσκορπίσθησαν ἐκεῖ ,
traditions.VUL: Post finem quadragínta annórum congregábo Ægýptum de pópulis , in quibus dispérsi fúerant .
traditions.KJV: At the end of forty years will I gather the Egyptians from the people whither they were scattered :

14.english_reference: And I will bring again the captivity of Egypt

traditions.WLC: וְ שַׁבְתִּי֙ אֶת שְׁב֣וּת מִצְרַ֔יִם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀποστρέψω τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν τῶν Αἰγυπτίων ,
traditions.VUL: Et redúcam captivitátem Ægýpti ,
traditions.KJV: And I will bring again the captivity of Egypt ,

14.english_reference: and will cause them to return [ into ] the land of Pathros , into the land of their habitation

traditions.WLC: וַ הֲשִׁבֹתִ֤י אֹתָ ם֙ אֶ֣רֶץ פַּתְר֔וֹס עַל אֶ֖רֶץ מְכֽוּרָתָ֑ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατοικίσω αὐτοὺς ἐν γῇ Φαθωρῆς , ἐν τῇ γῇ ὅθεν ἐλήμφθησαν ·
traditions.VUL: et collocábo eos in terra Phathúres , in terra nativitátis suæ :
traditions.KJV: and will cause them to return [ into ] the land of Pathros , into the land of their habitation ;

14.english_reference: and they shall be there a base kingdom

traditions.WLC: וְ הָ֥יוּ שָׁ֖ם מַמְלָכָ֥ה שְׁפָלָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσται ἀρχὴ ταπεινὴ
traditions.VUL: et erunt ibi in regnum húmile :
traditions.KJV: and they shall be there a base kingdom .

15.english_reference: It shall be the basest of the kingdoms

traditions.WLC: מִן הַ מַּמְלָכוֹת֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה שְׁפָלָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: παρὰ πάσας τὰς ἀρχάς ,
traditions.VUL: inter cétera regna erit humíllima ,
traditions.KJV: It shall be the basest of the kingdoms ;

15.english_reference: neither shall it exalt itself any more above the nations

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹֽא תִתְנַשֵּׂ֥א ע֖וֹד עַל הַ גּוֹיִ֑ם
traditions.LXX: οὐ μὴ ὑψωθῇ ἔτι ἐπὶ τὰ ἔθνη ·
traditions.VUL: et non elevábitur ultra super natiónes ,
traditions.KJV: neither shall it exalt itself any more above the nations :

15.english_reference: for I will diminish them , that they shall no more rule over the nations

traditions.WLC: וְ הִ֨מְעַטְתִּ֔י ם לְ בִלְתִּ֖י רְד֥וֹת בַּ גּוֹיִֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὀλιγοστοὺς αὐτοὺς ποιήσω τοῦ μὴ εἶναι αὐτοὺς πλείονας ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν .
traditions.VUL: et immínuam eos ne ímperent géntibus .
traditions.KJV: for I will diminish them , that they shall no more rule over the nations .

16.english_reference: And it shall be no more the confidence of the house of Israel , which bringeth [ their ] iniquity to remembrance , when they shall look after them

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹ֣א יִֽהְיֶה עוֹד֩ לְ בֵ֨ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל לְ מִבְטָח֙ מַזְכִּ֣יר עָוֺ֔ן בִּ פְנוֹתָ֖ ם אַחֲרֵי הֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἔσονται ἔτι τῷ οἴκῳ Ἰσραὴλ εἰς ἐλπίδα ἀναμιμνήσκουσαν ἀνομίαν , ἐν τῷ αὐτοὺς ἀκολουθῆσαι ὀπίσω αὐτῶν ·
traditions.VUL: Neque erunt ultra dómui Israel in confidéntia , docéntes iniquitátem , ut fúgiant , et sequántur eos :
traditions.KJV: And it shall be no more the confidence of the house of Israel , which bringeth [ their ] iniquity to remembrance , when they shall look after them :

16.english_reference: but they shall know that I [ am ] the Lord GOD

traditions.WLC: וְ יָ֣דְע֔וּ כִּ֥י אֲנִ֖י אֲדֹנָ֥ י יְהוִֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ γνώσονται ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι Κύριος .
traditions.VUL: et scient quia ego Dóminus Deus .
traditions.KJV: but they shall know that I [ am ] the Lord GOD .

17.english_reference: And it came to pass in the seven and twentieth year , in the first [ month ] , in the first [ day ] of the month

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֗י בְּ עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וָ שֶׁ֨בַע֙ שָׁנָ֔ה בָּֽ רִאשׁ֖וֹן בְּ אֶחָ֣ד לַ חֹ֑דֶשׁ
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἑβδόμῳ καὶ εἰκοστῷ ἔτει μιᾷ τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ πρώτου
traditions.VUL: Et factum est in vigésimo et séptimo anno , in primo , in una mensis :
traditions.KJV: And it came to pass in the seven and twentieth year , in the first [ month ] , in the first [ day ] of the month ,

17.english_reference: the word of the LORD came unto me , saying

traditions.WLC: הָיָ֥ה דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥ י לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: ἐγένετο λόγος Κυρίου πρὸς μὲ λέγων
traditions.VUL: factum est verbum Dómini ad me , dicens :
traditions.KJV: the word of the LORD came unto me , saying ,

18.english_reference: Son of man , Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyrus

traditions.WLC: בֶּן אָדָ֗ם נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֣ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּ֠בֶל הֶעֱבִ֨יד אֶת חֵיל֜ וֹ עֲבֹדָ֤ה גְדֹלָה֙ אֶל צֹ֔ר
traditions.LXX: Υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου , Ναβουχοδονοσὸρ βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος κατεδουλώσατο αὐτοῦ τὴν δύναμιν δουλείᾳ μεγάλῃ ἐπὶ Τύρου ·
traditions.VUL: Fili hóminis , Nabuchodónosor rex Babylónis servíre fecit exércitum suum servitúte magna advérsum Tyrum :
traditions.KJV: Son of man , Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyrus :

18.english_reference: every head [ was ] made bald , and every shoulder [ was ] peeled

traditions.WLC: כָּל רֹ֣אשׁ מֻקְרָ֔ח וְ כָל כָּתֵ֖ף מְרוּטָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: πᾶσα κεφαλὴ φαλακρά , καὶ πᾶς ὦμος μαδῶν ·
traditions.VUL: omne caput decalvátum , et omnis húmerus depilátus est :
traditions.KJV: every head [ was ] made bald , and every shoulder [ was ] peeled :

18.english_reference: yet had he no wages , nor his army , for Tyrus , for the service that he had served against it

traditions.WLC: וְ֠ שָׂכָר לֹא הָ֨יָה ל֤ וֹ וּ לְ חֵיל וֹ֙ מִ צֹּ֔ר עַל הָ עֲבֹדָ֖ה אֲשֶׁר עָבַ֥ד עָלֶֽי הָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ μισθὸς οὐκ ἐγενήθη αὐτῷ καὶ τῇ δυνάμει αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ Τύρον , καὶ τῆς δουλείας ἧς ἐδούλευσαν ἐπ᾽ αὐτήν .
traditions.VUL: et merces non est réddita ei , neque exercítui eius de Tyro pro servitúte , qua servívit mihi advérsus eam .
traditions.KJV: yet had he no wages , nor his army , for Tyrus , for the service that he had served against it :

19.english_reference: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD

traditions.WLC: לָ כֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣ י יְהוִ֔ה
traditions.LXX: τάδε λέγει κύριος Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Proptérea hæc dicit Dóminus Deus :
traditions.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ;

19.english_reference: Behold , I will give the land of Egypt unto Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon

traditions.WLC: הִנְ נִ֥י נֹתֵ֛ן לִ נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל אֶת אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם
traditions.LXX: Ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ δίδωμι τῷ Ναβουχοδονοσὸρ βασιλεῖ Βαβυλῶνος γῆν Αἰγύπτου ,
traditions.VUL: Ecce ego dabo Nabuchodónosor regem Babylónis in terra Ægýpti :
traditions.KJV: Behold , I will give the land of Egypt unto Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon ;

19.english_reference: and he shall take her multitude , and take her spoil , and take her prey

traditions.WLC: וְ נָשָׂ֨א הֲמֹנָ֜ הּ וְ שָׁלַ֤ל שְׁלָלָ הּ֙ וּ בָזַ֣ז בִּזָּ֔ הּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ προνομεύσει τὴν προνομὴν αὐτῆς καὶ σκυλεύσει τὰ σκῦλα αὐτῆς ,
traditions.VUL: et accípiet multitúdinem eius , et deprædábitur manúbias eius , et dirípiet spólia eius :
traditions.KJV: and he shall take her multitude , and take her spoil , and take her prey ;

19.english_reference: and it shall be the wages for his army

traditions.WLC: וְ הָיְתָ֥ה שָׂכָ֖ר לְ חֵילֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσται μισθὸς τῇ δυνάμει αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: et erit merces exercítui illíus ,
traditions.KJV: and it shall be the wages for his army .

20.english_reference: I have given him the land of Egypt [ for ] his labour wherewith he served against it

traditions.WLC: פְּעֻלָּת וֹ֙ אֲשֶׁר עָ֣בַד בָּ֔ הּ נָתַ֥תִּי ל֖ וֹ אֶת אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם
traditions.LXX: ἀντὶ τῆς λειτουργίας αὐτοῦ ἧς ἐδούλευσεν ἐπὶ Τύρον δέδωκα αὐτῷ γῆν Αἰγύπτου .
traditions.VUL: et óperi , quo servívit advérsus eam : dedi ei terram Ægýpti ,
traditions.KJV: I have given him the land of Egypt [ for ] his labour wherewith he served against it ,

20.english_reference: because they wrought for me , saith the Lord GOD

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁר֙ עָ֣שׂוּ לִ֔ י נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥ י יְהוִֽה
traditions.LXX: τάδε λέγει κύριος Κύριος
traditions.VUL: pro eo quod laboráverit mihi , ait Dóminus Deus .
traditions.KJV: because they wrought for me , saith the Lord GOD .

traditions.WLC: בַּ יּ֣וֹם הַ ה֗וּא
traditions.LXX: Ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ
traditions.VUL: In die illo
traditions.KJV: In that day

21.english_reference: will I cause the horn of the house of Israel to bud forth

traditions.WLC: אַצְמִ֤יחַ קֶ֨רֶן֙ לְ בֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
traditions.LXX: ἀνατελεῖ κέρας παντὶ τῷ οἴκῳ Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: pullulábit cornu dómui Israel ,
traditions.KJV: will I cause the horn of the house of Israel to bud forth ,

21.english_reference: and I will give thee the opening of the mouth in the midst of them

traditions.WLC: וּ לְ ךָ֛ אֶתֵּ֥ן פִּתְחֽוֹן פֶּ֖ה בְּ תוֹכָ֑ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ σοὶ δώσω στόμα ἀνεῳγμένον ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: et tibi dabo apértum os in médio eórum ,
traditions.KJV: and I will give thee the opening of the mouth in the midst of them ;

21.english_reference: and they shall know that I [ am ] the LORD

traditions.WLC: וְ יָדְע֖וּ כִּי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ γνώσονται ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι Κύριος .
traditions.VUL: et scient quia ego Dóminus .
traditions.KJV: and they shall know that I [ am ] the LORD .
